undefined_precision_aggregation: Per-seed null preserved; mean/sample SD use only defined precision values with defined_n; other endpoints keep their original seed sets.

comparator_selection.tie_rule: First in the explicitly listed external set

tests.rule: Fail if candidate forgetting is significantly higher: one-sided p_greater < .05
Pass only if final BAcc is significantly higher than Replay-BS: one-sided p_greater < .05
Fail if alpha=.02 ADR is significantly lower than original AA: one-sided p_less < .05
